criteria.text: A pending protected approval appears immediately as an actionable card in the originating session.
criteria.test_id: issue-1392-c1: lists a pending approval for a cloud-authenticated desktop

criteria.text: Approve and deny both resolve the exact pending approval.
criteria.test_id: issue-1392-c2: resolves the exact cloud-authenticated desktop approval

criteria.text: The bell badge count increments within approximately 30 seconds and the card is visible in the notification panel.
criteria.test_id: includes pending agent approvals so a blocked security gate always pings the bell

criteria.text: A pending AgentApproval with sessionId matching the open agent session renders an inline actionable approval card in the real transcript composition; nonmatching approvals do not render there.
criteria.test_id: issue-1392-c4: matching pending approval renders inline and nonmatching approval stays out of the transcript

criteria.text: Activating a local notification payload for a pending approval selects Agents, opens the originating session, and targets the request.
criteria.test_id: issue-1392-c5: a new approval pushes a notification whose activation targets its session and request

criteria.text: Approving a pending agent approval automatically resumes the originating session exactly once, carries the exact approval_id, and instructs the agent to retry the identical protected action once.
criteria.test_id: issue-1392-c6: approval resumes the origin once with the exact approval_id and one-retry instruction

criteria.text: Rejecting a pending agent approval automatically resumes the originating session exactly once and explicitly prevents the protected action from being performed.
criteria.test_id: issue-1392-c7: rejection resumes the origin once and forbids the protected action

criteria.text: A decision made while the originating session is working remains durably queued, dispatches no continuation immediately, and dispatches exactly once after onSessionIdle observes the session idle.
criteria.test_id: issue-1392-c8: a working origin keeps the continuation queued until its idle callback dispatches once

criteria.text: After restart, recoverAfterRestart dispatches an already queued decided approval exactly once using the persisted originating session mapping.
criteria.test_id: issue-1392-c9: restart recovery dispatches an already queued decided approval once

criteria.text: After trusted external-content taint, an interactive session whose root has the server-owned explicit bypass marker does not create a per-action approval and may consume the exact delegation action without approval_id.
criteria.test_id: issue-1392-c10: tainted interactive bypass mode needs no per-action delegation approval

criteria.text: After trusted external-content taint, the same interactive delegation in default permission mode remains pending and is forbidden without approval_id.
criteria.test_id: issue-1392-c11: the same tainted delegation remains gated in default mode

criteria.text: The MCP approval tool reports the bypass decision as not_required and rhythm_delegate_async proceeds with the original protected arguments without inventing or forwarding an approval_id.
criteria.test_id: issue-1392-c12: not_required approval result proceeds to async delegation without approval_id

criteria.text: Agent sessions persist and expose a dedicated server-owned explicit approval-bypass marker so approval policy never trusts permission_mode alone.
criteria.test_id: issue-1392-c13: session schema and model expose a dedicated server-owned explicit approval-bypass marker

criteria.text: A forced-bypass child under a default root remains subject to the external-content approval gate.
criteria.test_id: issue-1392-c14: a forced-bypass child under a default root remains gated

criteria.text: A delegated child under an explicit human-selected bypass root resolves that root authorization without copying the server-owned marker onto the child, and may proceed through the exact protected action without approval_id.
criteria.test_id: issue-1392-c15: a child under an explicit human-selected bypass root is allowed

criteria.text: A headless or AgentRunner-like bypass root without the explicit human-selected marker remains subject to the external-content approval gate.
criteria.test_id: issue-1392-c16: a headless bypass root without explicit human provenance remains gated

criteria.text: The first successful unread-notification poll establishes a startup baseline without replaying native banners for notifications that were already unread.
criteria.test_id: issue-1392-c17: startup unread baseline does not replay native notifications

criteria.text: A general AppNotification that first appears unread after startup emits exactly one native notification whose payload preserves its entity type and entity ID, while unchanged polls do not duplicate it.
criteria.test_id: issue-1392-c18: newly unread app notification pushes once with its exact navigation route

criteria.text: An immediate agent notification that becomes unread emits exactly one native notification, opens the Agents surface when activated, and a repeated event ID neither increments the bell nor pushes again.
criteria.test_id: issue-1392-c19: immediate agent notification pushes once and routes to Agents
